title: Arabic Typography Hygiene Rules
description: 5 mechanical typography rules + 13-source authority log. Extracted from arabic-ai-text-humanizer references/15-typography-hygiene.md (v2.4.1 through v2.4.5). These rules are register-INDEPENDENT — they apply to all Arabic prose regardless of classical / news / opinion / technical register.

authority_sources.name: King Fahd Complex for the Printing of the Holy Qur'an

rules.title: Arabic-English token spacing
rules.description: Insert a single space between Arabic and Latin tokens that abut. e.g., 'الذكاء الاصطناعيAI' -> 'الذكاء الاصطناعي AI'. Helps BIDI rendering.

rules.title: ASCII to Arabic punctuation conversion
rules.description: Convert ASCII punctuation in Arabic-context to native Arabic equivalents.
rules.implementation_hint: Only convert when preceding char is Arabic-block (\u0600-\u06FF). Do not convert inside English-context spans.

rules.title: No space before Arabic punctuation
rules.description: Arabic punctuation (،; ؛, ؟, :, !, .) must be adjacent to the preceding word — no leading space. Universal rule from all 13 style guides.

rules.title: No space inside parentheses
rules.description: No space between parenthesis and content; no space between closing paren and following punctuation. Source: Kaplan + proof-reading-service.
rules.implementation_hint: (1) strip space immediately after ( when followed by Arabic letter; (2) strip space before ) when preceded by Arabic letter; (3) strip space between ) and following punctuation

rules.title: Kashida (tatweel U+0640) removal
rules.description: Strip the Arabic kashida (ـ, U+0640) from encoded body text. Kashida is for display typography (logos, posters, justified-text rendering), NEVER for encoded body text. AI translators sometimes inject it to 'look more Arabic' which is the opposite of professional Arabic typography.
rules.implementation_hint: Strip all U+0640 from input. UNIVERSAL (all registers).

rules.title: Em-dash to Arabic comma in Arabic context
rules.description: Em-dash (—, U+2014) is a Latin import; convert to Arabic comma (،) when surrounded by Arabic letters. Preserve in English-context (e.g., 'OpenAI — مؤسسة' keeps em-dash because I is Latin).
rules.implementation_hint: Only convert when both flanks are Arabic-block characters.

rules.title: Comma to semicolon before unambiguous causal connectors
rules.description: Semicolon is the correct mark before causal clauses per multiple sources. Convert , -> ؛ before لأن / لأنّ / لذلك / لذا / ومن ثَمَّ. Skip ambiguous connectors (إذ / حيث — 'when' vs 'because').

rules.title: List-و insertion (Itwadi rule)
rules.description: In Arabic lists with 3+ items, insert و before items 2..n (opposite of English's 'and before last item only'). Detection conservative: only when 3+ comma-separated tokens are each a single Arabic word.
rules.implementation_hint: Detect lists of 3+ tokens; insert و before items 2..n; do NOT treat short-clause commas as lists.

rules.title: ASCII quotes to Arabic guillemets (classical register only)
rules.description: Convert "..." to «...» in classical register; preserve ASCII in news/opinion/technical. Sources split between formal (guillemets) and modern (ASCII).
